title: Maximizing the Steklov eigenvalues on trees with a diameter constraint
summary: We study the first nonzero Steklov eigenvalue $λ_2(T,δΩ)$ of the Dirichlet-to-Neumann operator on a finite tree $T$ with leaf boundary $δΩ$, under a constraint on the diameter $D$. He and Hua [Calc. Var. PDE, 2022] showed that $λ_2(T) \leq 2/D$ for any tree of diameter $D$, with the even-diameter equality case fully characterized. For odd $D$, the geometric picture underlying the sharp configurations has remained unclear beyond diameter three. We determine this picture completely for all odd diameters $D = 2r+1 \geq 5$.
